fields.aboutBodyOne: founder of nc studio. inspired by film and drawn to genuine moments, i document people and events with a timeless, cinematic approach.
fields.aboutBodyTwo: my goal is simple: to preserve how it felt, not just how it looked.
fields.aboutBodyThree: the loud moments, the quiet ones and everything that made the room yours.
fields.principleOneText: your day is captured with feeling, not just as a checklist of moments.
fields.principleTwoText: gentle guidance when needed, with space for natural moments to unfold.
fields.principleThreeText: clean colours, soft movement and a timeless edit that feels true to the day.
fields.workLead: events, weddings, portraits and story-led film.
